verdict.rationale: A system-to-system transaction channel is a fair question for a government administrative portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a JavaScript shell behind an account and a Cloudflare-challenged ministry site, with no documented system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers, or published enrollment path.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
